picks.question: Will the Fed increase interest rates by 25 bps after the September 2026 meeting?
picks.why: Markets price a September 2026 hike; the path of policy rates drives borrowing costs everywhere.

picks.question: Billionaire one-time wealth tax passes in California election 2026?
picks.why: A state-level one-time wealth tax would test mobility, revenue and constitutional limits of taxing capital.

picks.question: Will the Iranian regime fall before 2027?
picks.why: Regime change in Iran would reprice oil, shipping risk and regional security premiums.

picks.question: OpenAI announces it has achieved AGI before 2027?
picks.why: An AGI declaration would shift expectations for AI capital spending, labor demand and regulation.

picks.question: Will an AI lab announce another Millennium Prize solution by December 31, 2026?
picks.why: AI solving a Millennium Prize problem would mark a real jump in machine mathematical reasoning.

picks.question: Will J.D. Vance win the 2028 Republican presidential nomination?
picks.why: A coin-flip nomination race shapes expected trade, tax and fiscal policy after 2028.
